messages:
maria: quick sanity check — trying to onboard mosaic-4-small, runtime fails with tokenizer/vocab missing even though config.json has a weights URI. can someone confirm the asset pointers?

sam: can you paste the config.json snippet? often the manifest vs config weight path mismatch is the culprit.

maria: sure — here's the relevant part:```json
{
  "model_name": "mosaic-4-small",
  "assets": {
    "weights": "gs://redwood-models/mosaic4/small/weights.bin",
    "tokenizer": "gs://redwood-models/mosaic4/small/tokenizer/"
  },
  "serve": {
    "max_seq": 2048
  }
}```

ash: the tokenizer path looks like a directory — runtime expects a tokenizer.json or vocab file at the exact path. if the manifest has tokenizer/tokenizer.json but config points to tokenizer/ it can fail.

sam: also check weight sharding. if weights are sharded like weights-00001-of-00004.bin we need a pattern field or a manifest file listing shards. runtime currently errors with a 404 on first shard sometimes.

jiang: FYI infra-bot reported permission errors earlier today for the redwood-models bucket. infra-bot: any ACLs changed?

infra-bot: automated alert: gs://redwood-models ACL updated 2026-02-18T09:12Z by deploy-service — public-read removed. Access for runtime service-acct still permitted. Check iam:roles/storage.objectViewer for service principal.

liz: quick repro I ran locally: `rlint validate-config configs/mosaic4-small.json` produced:```
ERROR: missing_asset: tokenizer/tokenizer.json not found
WARN: weights_shard_pattern not specified, found 4 shards
INFO: storage_acl: bucket access OK for service-acct@redwood-prod
```

ash: fix options: (1) point config.assets.tokenizer to the explicit tokenizer.json file, (2) add a small manifest.json at assets/manifest.json listing exact files, or (3) add a `weight_shard_pattern` property like `weights-*.bin`.

maria: good — I can update config to explicit files and add shard pattern. quick question about tokenizer quirks: this model's tokenizer has an unusual special token `<|pad|>` index 0, but our serving defaults assume PAD=1. do we need an override?

sam: yes — add `tokenizer_overrides: { \"pad_token_id\": 0 }` to the config. also add `vocab_offset` if subtoken indexing differs. we've seen off-by-one causing EVAL regression.

liz: small nit — add a short comment in the config explaining why override exists so future reviewers don't revert it.

jiang: when you push the change, tag `#onboard-gate` and mention me for a quick infra permission recheck. i'll also run a canned smoke run on dedicated infra.

maria: plan: i'll update config to explicit tokenizer/tokenizer.json + weight_shard_pattern and add tokenizer_overrides + comment, open PR, tag #onboard-gate, and ping @jiang & @sam for smoke. ETA ~ today EOD. thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: sounds good — if you want me to review fast, drop the PR link here and i'll do a quick pass.

maria: will do — thanks!
